mentions.name: MouseHouse
mentions.description: MouseHouse is colony management software for biomedical research labs that replaces spreadsheet-based animal colony tracking. It lets researchers share colony information with other researchers at their institutions and browse the mouse lines other labs maintain, enabling collaboration and making it easier to find and borrow mouse lines for experiments. Currently in closed beta at Harvard.
mentions.problem: Animal colony management is largely managed in Excel sheets, with no integrations to related systems or hardware sensing.
mentions.audience: Biomedical researchers at academic institutions and the broader research community looking to discover and borrow mouse lines from other labs
mentions.source_excerpt:
Software for biomedical research labs.

Animal colony management is largely managed in Excel sheets, with no integrations to related systems or hardware sensing. We're working on the spreadsheet problem first, so that biomedical researchers can share information about their colonies with other researchers at their institutions, and explore the lines that other labs have. This opens up collaboration options and makes it much easier for the research community to find out what mouse lines other labs have (and may borrow for their own experiments).
